versions.description_html:
Discover Work IQ in Microsoft 365 Copilot. Learn how it gives AI memory, understands team relationships, protects your data, and powers autonomous agents.

The AI on your desk is missing the most important thing about your work. It reads the one file you paste in, then forgets your team and your projects.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Work IQ Actually Is
  • Why Copilot Needed A Memory
  • The Three Layers, In Plain Words
  • How It Understands People And Relationships
  • It Only Sees What You Are Allowed To See
  • Where Your Data Lives
  • What It Means For Agents
  • What It Does Not Do
  • Recap And One Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Beyond Copilot: Building Enterprise AI Agents That Actually Work with Copilot Studio with Manpreet Singh [MVP-MCT]
  • How Microsoft 365 & Copilot Are Redesigning the Way We Work with Tracy van der Schyff [MVP]
  • More AI & Copilot episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of AI & Copilot: the most-listened episodes
